name: Horrible Goat 29
author: mostafabazyar
description: Pill red button that expands on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, border-radius becomes 3px, border-color becomes #ff0000, height becomes 2em.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Horrible Goat 29</title>
<style>
/* Horrible Goat 29 by mostafabazyar — https://uiverse.io/mostafabazyar/horrible-goat-29 */
button {
  position: relative;
  margin: 1rem;
  z-index: 2;
  border-radius: 8px;
  appearance: none;
  padding: 1em 2em;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

button {
  padding: 1.2rem;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

button::before {
  content: "6";
  position: absolute;
  display: flex;
  top: -0.75em;
  right: -0.75em;
  height: 1.8em;
  width: 1.8em;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: red;
  color: white;
  z-index: 999;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

button:hover {
  border-radius: 3px;
  border-color: red;
}

button:hover::before {
  height: 2em;
  width: 2em;
  font-size: 1.5em;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>Notification By HTML Data attribute</button>

</body>
</html>
